label: BBC 013
themeEn: How advertisers make us spend money

ex.en: We call this a celebrity endorsement.
ex.zh: 我們稱這種做法為名人代言。

fam: endorse v. 代言；贊同；背書

tips.t: celebrity endorsement 名人代言；endorse a candidate 支持候選人；endorse a check 在支票背面背書。

ex.en: When we're unsure, we don't know what to do, it's kind of easy to follow the lead of those who we think are credible or knowledgeable.
ex.zh: 當我們不確定、不知道該怎麼做時，跟隨那些我們認為可信或有知識的人，是相當容易的。

fam: incredible adj. 難以置信的；極好的

tips.t: credible（可信的）≠ credulous（輕信的）≠ creditable（值得稱讚的）。a credible source 可靠的消息來源。

ex.en: In recent years, many fast-food chains have installed touchscreen machines for people to order their food.
ex.zh: 近年來，很多速食連鎖店都裝了觸控螢幕點餐機讓人點餐。

fam: installment n. 分期付款（的一期）

tips.t: Part 1、Part 7 常見：Workers are installing a new sign. 工人正在安裝新招牌；pay in installments 分期付款。

ex.en: Not all people, but I think there's definitely a large proportion of people who may feel judged in those instances and may say no.
ex.zh: 不是所有人，但我覺得確實有很大比例的人在那些情況下可能會覺得被評判，然後說不要。

tips.t: a large / small proportion of ～ 大／小部分的～；in proportion to 與～成比例（The fee is in proportion to the size of the order. 費用依訂單大小比例計算）。

ex.en: Because you've got more time and you're not being judged, you're very much more inclined to actually say yes to these things.
ex.zh: 因為你有比較多時間，又不會被評判，所以你會更傾向對這些東西說好。

tips.t: be inclined to do 傾向做～（to 後接原形動詞，Part 5 常考）：Customers are more inclined to buy when prices are clearly displayed.

pos.m: 向上銷售，推銷加購（更貴或更多的商品）

ex.en: If you upsell something, then you get someone to spend more.
ex.zh: 如果你 upsell 某樣東西，就是讓某人花更多錢。

tips.t: 相關：cross-sell 交叉銷售（推薦相關產品）；upgrade 升級。業務、零售情境常見。

ex.en: A basket spend is the total amount that someone spends in one transaction, on everything that's in their basket.
ex.zh: basket spend 是某人在一筆交易中，為購物籃裡所有東西花的總金額。

tips.t: 銀行、信用卡情境必考：online transactions 網路交易；a transaction fee 交易手續費；transaction history 交易紀錄。

pos.m: 跳脫框架思考，發揮創意

ex.en: Takwa says that they needed to think outside the box.
ex.zh: Takwa 說他們需要 think outside the box。

tips.t: 徵才廣告常見：We are looking for someone who can think outside the box. 我們在找能跳脫框架思考的人。
